critical_code_review_comments: Status pill in UI shows text 'Aktif' only; copy spec expected 'Chat AI Aktif'. The header already labels CHAT AI, so this is acceptable but worth consistency check.
Template run response uses `results: {<id>: ...}` dict (not `result_ids: [...]`). Frontend handles this fine; just a note for future API consumers.

SSE stream from /api/ai/chat emits default `message` events whose payloads carry inner `type` fields (status/tool/delta/result/done) rather than using SSE `event:` headers. Works correctly but worth documenting.
